about: KDHE stream advisories issued before the news flash feed's window, entered by hand from the release (the release pages answer 403 to automated reading, so each row is taken from the release's text as search engines index it). Each row stays open until a rescission is read in KDHE's feed or entered here ("rescission": {"date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "url": ..., "title": ...}). Read by pipeline/ingest/ks_kdhe_stream_advisories.py.
